nodes.title: ARTFAT LLM PROMPTER — QUICK GUIDE
widgets_values:
ARTFAT LLM PROMPTER — QUICK GUIDE
=================================

WHERE TO ENTER YOUR PROMPT
--------------------------
>>> LLM ON  — TYPE YOUR IDEA / SCENE / EXISTING PROMPT INTO THE "user_preset" BOX.
    YOUR TEXT IS TOP PRIORITY; THE MODEL BUILDS THE FINAL PROMPT AROUND IT.
    LEAVE IT EMPTY TO AUTO-GENERATE A FRESH SCENE.

>>> LLM OFF — TYPE YOUR OWN READY PROMPT DIRECTLY INTO THE "final_prompt" BOX.
    IT GOES STRAIGHT TO CLIP AS-IS, NO REWRITING (ALL LLM-ONLY FIELDS GREY OUT).

The finished prompt always ends up in "final_prompt" (editable, copyable) and feeds the sampler.

BASIC FLOW (LLM ON)
-------------------
1. Pick a Style preset in "system_prompt" — the main look dial (B0 everyday
   smartphone, B33/B34 first-person POV, A–K aesthetics). It auto-fills the box.
2. (Optional) Pick an Instruction preset in "instruction" — the task
   (Describe->prompt, Refine & expand, Tags, Replace subject...).
3. Type your idea / scene / existing prompt in "user_preset" (see top).
4. (Optional) Attach 1–2 reference images — described faithfully; with two
   images, Image 1 is the main subject.
5. Run -> the finished prompt appears in "final_prompt", ~75–100 words, ready.

KEY NUANCES
-----------
- Keep prompts under 512 tokens (Flux/Krea text-encoder limit). The presets
  already target this — don't force giant prompts.
- Prose beats tags for these models. Only request tags if you specifically need them.
- Using a "thinking" LLM? Raise "max_tokens" — reasoning eats the budget and can
  cut the prompt short.
- "control_after_generate = fixed" freezes a prompt you like (otherwise it
  regenerates each run).

HANDY PRESETS
-------------
- 0_Prompt_Enhancer — one-click polish of any idea/tags, style-neutral.
- Subject_FaceBody_Reference — locks a character's face & body from a photo
  (consistency + face/body swap).

# Selfism Simple — Setup

The bare, fast version: load workflow → type your idea → Queue. No detailers, no upscalers — just clean generation with the LLM Prompter.

## Step 0 — Start Here
1. Drag the workflow `.json` into ComfyUI.
2. **ComfyUI-Manager → Install Missing Custom Nodes** → restart.
3. Put the models in place (below), type your idea, hit **Queue**.

## Model Links

**diffusion_models/**
- [Selfora_Krea2T_v1_fp8.safetensors](REPLACE_WITH_SELFORA_CIVITAI_URL_AFTER_UPLOAD)
  *(GGUF version optional, for low VRAM — toggle the GGUF loader)*

**text_encoders/**
- [qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Krea-2/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors)

### VAE
Several VAEs work fine with this checkpoint — use whichever you have (all go in `models/vae/`):

* **Qwen Image VAE** (standard) — [qwen_image_vae.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Krea-2/resolve/main/vae/qwen_image_vae.safetensors)
* **Wan 2.1 VAE** (regular) — [wan_2.1_vae.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged/resolve/main/split_files/vae/wan_2.1_vae.safetensors)
* **Wan 2.1 VAE fp32** — [Wan2_1_VAE_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/WanVideo_comfy/resolve/main/Wan2_1_VAE_fp32.safetensors)
* **krea2RealVae (v10)** — [krea2RealVae_v10.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/artsyww/KREA2REALVAE/resolve/main/krea2RealVae_v10.safetensors)

**loras/**
- none required — realism is baked into Selfora. (Your own character LoRA goes here.)

## Model Storage

```
📂 ComfyUI/models/
├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   └── Selfora_Krea2T_v1_fp8.safetensors
├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   └── qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors
├── 📂 vae/
│   └── qwen_image_vae.safetensors
├── 📂 loras/
│   └── (your character LoRA, optional)
│   ├── 📂 upscale_models/
│   │   ├── 4xPurePhoto-RealPLSKR
│   │  
└── 📂 LLM/(for the Artfat LLM Prompter)
    ├── <your model>.gguf
    └── <its matching mmproj>.gguf
```
## 🔍 Upscaler Models  →  models/upscale_models/

### 🔸 4xPurePhoto-RealPLSKR (main upscaler — used in Selfism)
- **File:** `4xPurePhoto-RealPLSKR.pth` (28.3 MB)
  [direct](https://github.com/starinspace/StarinspaceUpscale/releases/download/Models/4xPurePhoto-RealPLSKR.pth) · [openmodeldb](https://openmodeldb.info/models/4x-PurePhoto-RealPLSKR)

### 🔸 1xSkinContrast-SuperUltraCompact (skin enhancement)
- **File:** `1xSkinContrast-SuperUltraCompact.pth`
  [openmodeldb](https://openmodeldb.info/models/1x-SkinContrast-SuperUltraCompact)

Other good upscalers (optional, same realistic vibe):
- 4xNomosWebPhoto_RealPLKSR (softer on skin) — [direct](https://github.com/Phhofm/models/releases/download/4xNomosWebPhoto_RealPLKSR/4xNomosWebPhoto_RealPLKSR.safetensors)
- 4x-ClearRealityV1 (sharper photoreal) — [openmodeldb](https://openmodeldb.info/models/4x-ClearRealityV1)
- 4xNomos8k_atd_jpg (great for phone/jpg feel) — [openmodeldb](https://openmodeldb.info/models/4x-Nomos8k-atd-jpg)
- Skin add-on (1x pass): 1x-ITF-SkinDiffDetail-Lite-v1 — [direct](https://huggingface.co/uwg/upscaler/resolve/main/ESRGAN/1x-ITF-SkinDiffDetail-Lite-v1.pth)
- Avoid for this look: 4x-UltraSharp (can go plastic/CGI on skin)

## Required Custom Nodes
Easiest: **ComfyUI-Manager → Install Missing Custom Nodes**.

**My nodes:**
- Artfat LLM Prompter — [github.com/artfat-creator/artfat-comfyui-llm-prompter](https://github.com/artfat-creator/artfat-comfyui-llm-prompter)

**Third-party:**
- ComfyUI-GGUF (GGUF model loader) — [github.com/city96/ComfyUI-GGUF](https://github.com/city96/ComfyUI-GGUF)
- rgthree-comfy (Any Switch — the loader toggle) — [github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy](https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy)
- RES4LYF (er_sde sampler) — [github.com/ClownsharkBatwing/RES4LYF](https://github.com/ClownsharkBatwing/RES4LYF)
- ComfyUI-KJNodes (Save Image + caption) — [github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes)

_All other nodes (loaders, KSampler, latent, VAE decode) are ComfyUI **core** — nothing to install._

## LLM for the Artfat LLM Prompter
Put a **text GGUF + its vision mmproj** in `ComfyUI/models/LLM/`, then point the node's `model` and `mmproj` widgets at them. Pick by VRAM — all uncensored + vision:

**🟢 ~8 GB — Gemma 3 4B (abliterated · vision)** — small, fast, works on any llama.cpp:
- model — [Q6_K · 3.2 GB](https://huggingface.co/bartowski/mlabonne_gemma-3-4b-it-abliterated-GGUF/resolve/main/mlabonne_gemma-3-4b-it-abliterated-Q6_K.gguf)
- mmproj — [f16 · 851 MB](https://huggingface.co/bartowski/mlabonne_gemma-3-4b-it-abliterated-GGUF/resolve/main/mmproj-mlabonne_gemma-3-4b-it-abliterated-f16.gguf)

**🔵 ~12 GB ⭐ used in Selfism — Qwen3.6-14B-A3B-FableVibes-Q4_K_M (uncensored · vision · thinking):**
- model — [Q4_K_M · 7.5 GB](https://huggingface.co/tvall43/Qwen3.6-14B-A3B-FableVibes-GGUF/resolve/main/Qwen3.6-14B-A3B-FableVibes-Q4_K_M.gguf?download=true)
- mmproj — [BF16 · 922 MB](https://huggingface.co/tvall43/Qwen3.6-14B-A3B-FableVibes-GGUF/resolve/main/Qwen3.6-14B-A3B-FableVibes-mmproj-F16.gguf)
- ⚠️ AMD / older llama.cpp: if it won't load, use Gemma 3 4B above (works everywhere).

💡 Tight on VRAM? Enable **force_offload** on the prompter — it unloads the LLM after writing the prompt, freeing VRAM for Selfora.

## Usage
Ships with working defaults — just hit Queue.
- **Resolution:** keep the shorter side ~1024 (below that faces/detail suffer). Dimensions multiple of 16.
- **Prompt tips:** for open eyes write *"relaxed wide-open eyes looking at the camera"* — avoid *"laughing / big grin"* (squints eyes). Negatives only bite at CFG > 1 (ignored at CFG 1 turbo).
- Using a character LoRA? Load it in the LoRA loader and start your prompt with its trigger word.

Like it? Support me! https://www.patreon.com/c/ArtfatAI
